# FlowPro

> FlowPro checks whether AI assistants can read a website and implements the fixes.
> A free Chrome extension runs 17 checks in the browser; the audit and the estimate
> cost nothing, and the work is priced to the scope you agree. Operated by
> Ivan Karabeinikau Digital Engineering (NIP: 9512646879), Warsaw, Poland.
> English and Polish.

## Free tool

- AI Visibility Checker (Chrome extension): 17 checks in four groups — crawlability,
  structured data, meta tags, content structure. Runs locally, no account, audited
  page data never leaves the browser.
- Score 0–100 with four verdicts: Hard for AI to read (0–39), Partly readable by AI
  (40–69), Readable by AI (70–89), Ready to be cited (90–100).
- Landing page: https://flowpro.dev/ai-visibility/

## Free audit

- Send a website address and Ivan runs the check on your pages himself, then
  replies within one business day with what is failing, which of it is worth
  paying for, and which of it you could do yourself. No charge, no commitment.

## Paid service

- AI Readiness Fix: robots.txt rules for documented AI crawlers, sitemap.xml and
  llms.txt created or repaired, JSON-LD, meta tags and content structure on the
  pages that matter, re-check with the extension plus a 30-day follow-up re-check.
- Price: by estimate, itemised and agreed in writing before any work starts. Most
  small-business sites land between 2 000 and 6 000 PLN net. Invoiced in PLN or EUR.
  Not VAT-registered (art. 113 of the Polish VAT Act).
- Page: https://flowpro.dev/ai-visibility/fix/

## What FlowPro does not promise

- No promise that ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or Gemini will mention or cite a site.
  Platforms decide that, and most brand mentions in AI answers come from third-party
  pages rather than the brand's own site.
- The checker measures documented preconditions for access and interpretation. It
  does not query any AI assistant.
